@vue/language-tools.reason: Uses TypeScript Compiler API programmatic layer, absent in TypeScript 7.0 until 7.1
@vue/language-tools.fix: Pin typescript to ^6.x, or install @typescript/typescript6 and configure alias

@astrojs/language-server.reason: Uses TypeScript Compiler API for Astro template type-checking

svelte-language-server.reason: Uses TypeScript Compiler API for Svelte template type-checking

@angular/compiler-cli.reason: Uses TypeScript Compiler API for Angular template type-checking

ts-node.reason: Wraps TypeScript Compiler API for runtime transpilation
ts-node.fix: Use tsx or swc-node as replacements, or pin typescript to ^6.x

ts-morph.reason: Built entirely on the TypeScript Compiler API
ts-morph.fix: Wait for ts-morph TypeScript 7.1 support or pin typescript to ^6.x

@mdx-js/mdx.reason: MDX type-checking embeds the TypeScript Compiler API, absent in TypeScript 7.0 until 7.1

typescript-eslint.reason: typescript-eslint reads types via the TypeScript Compiler API, which TypeScript 7.0 does not export until 7.1. v8.65.0 (2026-07-20) added a warning when TS 7 is detected, but its typescript peer range is still >=4.8.4 <6.1.0
typescript-eslint.fix: Run typescript-eslint against @typescript/typescript6 side-by-side, or pin typescript to ^6.x

@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree.reason: Parses and type-resolves via the TypeScript Compiler API, absent in TypeScript 7.0 until 7.1
@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree.fix: Install @typescript/typescript6 side-by-side, or pin typescript to ^6.x

vue-tsc.reason: Wraps the TypeScript Compiler API (via Volar) to type-check Vue SFC templates
vue-tsc.fix: Pin typescript to ^6.x, or install @typescript/typescript6 and run tsc6

svelte-check.reason: Uses the TypeScript Compiler API (via svelte-language-server) to type-check Svelte templates

@astrojs/check.reason: Astro's type-check CLI drives the TypeScript Compiler API (via @astrojs/language-server)

@typescript-eslint/parser.reason: Parses and type-resolves via the TypeScript Compiler API, absent in TypeScript 7.0 until 7.1
@typescript-eslint/parser.fix: Run against @typescript/typescript6 side-by-side, or pin typescript to ^6.x

ts-loader.reason: webpack loader that calls the TypeScript Compiler API (createProgram / transpileModule) to compile and type-check
ts-loader.fix: Switch to esbuild-loader or swc-loader, or pin typescript to ^6.x

fork-ts-checker-webpack-plugin.reason: Runs a full TypeScript type-check via the Compiler API in a worker process
fork-ts-checker-webpack-plugin.fix: Pin typescript to ^6.x until the plugin targets the TypeScript 7.1 API

rollup-plugin-typescript2.reason: Rollup plugin built on the TypeScript Compiler API (language service) for compile + type-check
rollup-plugin-typescript2.fix: Use @rollup/plugin-typescript in transpile-only mode with esbuild/swc, or pin typescript to ^6.x

@rollup/plugin-typescript.reason: Invokes the TypeScript Compiler API to emit and type-check during Rollup builds
@rollup/plugin-typescript.fix: Switch emit to esbuild/swc and type-check separately, or pin typescript to ^6.x

ts-jest.reason: Compiles and type-checks test files through the TypeScript Compiler API
ts-jest.fix: Use @swc/jest or babel-jest for transform, or pin typescript to ^6.x

@microsoft/api-extractor.reason: Analyzes .d.ts rollups via the TypeScript Compiler API
@microsoft/api-extractor.fix: Pin typescript to ^6.x until api-extractor supports the TypeScript 7.1 API

typedoc.reason: Reads program symbols and types via the TypeScript Compiler API to generate docs
typedoc.fix: Pin typescript to ^6.x until TypeDoc supports the TypeScript 7.1 API

dts-bundle-generator.reason: Builds bundled type declarations via the TypeScript Compiler API

tsd.reason: Runs type assertions by driving the TypeScript Compiler API

tsup.reason: Generates .d.ts through the TypeScript Compiler API; its declaration step crashes on 7.0 with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading useCaseSensitiveFileNames)"
tsup.fix: Build with `--dts false` and emit declarations via tsc, or pin typescript to ^6.x until tsup supports the native compiler
